capabilities: Chat with coding-agent CLIs that run with the vault as working directory
Inline-edit selected note text with word-level diff preview
Trigger slash commands, skills, and @mentions of files, subagents, and MCP servers
Toggle plan mode for explore-then-approve workflows
Manage multiple chat tabs with conversation history, fork, resume, and compact
extras: Unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI, Cursor, Anysphere, or Factory; desktop only (macOS, Linux, Windows); requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. README includes extensive troubleshooting for CLI detection, proxies, and Node.js PATH issues, and a privacy section explaining what is sent to provider APIs and stored locally in vault/.buildian/. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This project is based on Claudian and modified to adapt Claudian's agent workflow for provider-backed coding CLIs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run ACP coding agents like Grok Build, Cursor Agent, or Factory Droid directly against vault files.

relations.evidence: This project is based on Claudian and modified to adapt Claudian's agent workflow
connects your vault to ACP coding agents, including the xAI Grok Build CLI

requires.name: Grok CLI, Cursor Agent CLI, or Droid CLI
provider authentication (grok login, cursor-agent login, or Droid browser login)

summary: AI agent chat sidebar that runs provider-backed coding-agent CLIs (Grok Build, Cursor Agent, Factory Droid) to read, edit, and search vault files.
